rationale: bus_2 is under-voltage at 0.925 pu, below the 0.95 pu minimum. Required correction is 0.95 - 0.925 = 0.025 pu. With sensitivity dVm/dQ = 0.006 pu/Mvar, the minimum reactive support is 0.025 / 0.006 = 4.1667 Mvar. Choosing 4.17 Mvar (within [0, 20]) raises bus_2 to ~0.95002 pu, restoring feasibility at near-minimum cost.
